voiceControl.isListening.description: Checks whether voice control is listening to your microphone right now.

voiceControl.status.description: Tells you how voice control is doing right now.
voiceControl.status.returns: engine (the speech recognizer in use), state, message (a status line), listening (true/false) and inputDevice (the chosen microphone; empty means the default).

voiceControl.startListening.description: Starts listening to your microphone for voice commands. Fails with an error when no microphone or recognizer is available.
voiceControl.startListening.returns: true when it is listening now.

voiceControl.commands.description: Lists all your voice commands from the Voice Control page.
voiceControl.commands.returns: A list of commands. Each has id, name, enabled, phrase (what to say), location (Exact, Start or Anywhere), stopAfter, overrideGlobal and confidenceThreshold (0-100).

voiceControl.setCommandState.description: Turns one voice command on or off. Fails with an error when no command has that name.

parameters.command: The voice command's name or id, like "Switch to gameplay".

voiceControl.setCommandState.returns: The new state: true for on, false for off.

voiceControl.setCommand.description: Changes what you have to say for a voice command. Can also make a new command. Fails with an error when the command is not found (and create is off) or the phrase is empty.

parameters.command: The voice command's name or id, like "Switch to gameplay".
parameters.phrase: What you have to say, like "go to gameplay". Needed.
parameters.location: Optional. Where in what you say the phrase must be: "Exact" (all of it), "Start" or "Anywhere". Leave it out to keep it as it is.
parameters.create: Optional. true makes a new command with this name when none exists. Default false.

voiceControl.setCommand.returns: The command after the change, with the same details as voiceControl.commands.

voiceControl.setInputDevice.description: Picks which microphone voice control listens to. The choice is saved.

parameters.device: The microphone's name or id from voiceControl.inputDevices. Empty or "Default" uses your computer's default microphone.

voiceControl.inputDevices.description: Lists the microphones voice control can listen to.
voiceControl.inputDevices.returns: A list of microphones. Each has id, name and isDefault (true for your computer's default).

voiceControl.dictationLog.description: Shows what voice control heard recently. Handy to see why a command did not run.
voiceControl.dictationLog.returns: A list of heard phrases. Each has time, text, confidencePercent (how sure it was, 0-100), commands (which ones ran) and ignored.
